notes.title: Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Whoops! Fixed some bugs. Some bugs went unseen while exporting Season 3.
-Fixed issue where winning was impossible in Hallway Top Mode
-Fixed issue where wins, current time, and highscore weren't shown or tracked in Climb Mode
-Fixed issue where floor wouldn't game over in RNG 3D
Thank you for your patience in these matters. Enjoy dodging, weaving, and jumping!

notes.title: Dodge & Weave Season 3
notes.notes: [previewyoutube=tkMTyg1UZpA;leftthumb][/previewyoutube] Jump, climb, and fall your way to victory in this newest Dodge & Weave Update. Season 3 changes the game in big ways. Larger top down maps, full 3D control, controller support, and so much more. 10 new levels to beat in record times, 10 new songs, and 22 achievements to unlock!

notes.title: Dodge & Weave Season 2 Is Here!
notes.notes: Dodge & Weave Season 2: The Remix Level Pack has arrived! It includes 10 remixed versions of your favorite levels with 19 achievements to be earned by playing them. New additions include character skins, and the ability to play any level's theme from the main menu! [previewyoutube=ETdwU81scyk;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Season 2 is coming October 14th
notes.notes: The newest level pack is coming October 14th! The Remix Level Pack will have 10 remixed versions of your favorite levels. The Remix Level Pack will be free for anyone who owns Dodge & Weave. https://youtu.be/He-H-nP19TA

notes.title: Dodge & Weave Season 1: The Waves Level Pack
notes.notes:
The newest Dodge & Weave Level Pack is here! The Waves Level Pack brings with it 8 of the hardest levels in Dodge & Weave so far! Level Select buttons on game over and win screens, a level pack selector in the main menu, SFX for winning and losing, and a random level selector. 
https://youtu.be/lFf9o4XnAhk

notes.title: The Toxic Level Pack
notes.notes:
Dodge & Weave presents The Toxic Level Pack! Enjoy 10 new levels while the game makes fun of you every step along the way. There are 5 new achievements to be earned and a new hub to better track your wins and losses
*Bug fixes*
-Patched Medium Mode losses not tracking
-Patched projectile in Death Mode that wouldn't hit player
-Patched being able to pause in menu screens
-Patched WASD making noises in menu screens
-Patched mouse cursor not showing up on Endless Game Over screen
-Made Easy Mode easier. (Original still available under Easy Classic both modes count towards Easy Mode wins and losses)

notes.title: Update News
notes.notes:
As you may have seen there are now 45 hidden achievements linked to Dodge & Weave. When the new update comes out these will be available to be seen and unlocked. As of right now there is no way to see them or unlock them.
The new level pack should be launching by the end of May, with new levels to play and big fixes. The update is in the end stages of development and I'm just polishing up the final result and getting trailers ready.
Thank you for your patience and news should be coming soon!

notes.title: Post Launch Updates
notes.notes: Hi everyone, posting this a few hours before Dodge & Weave releases and I cannot contain the excitement for the launch of my first ever game. I just want to let everyone know that there is already a new level pack in development which will be completely free to anyone who purchases Dodge & Weave. I'm not ready quite yet to share details but it's about 1/4 of the way done and it's going to be a fun one
